Cost: Medtech-made: DV15 Medical Tech and 500eb of materials per dose
Type: Pharmaceutical

Pharmaceutical; needs Medtech Rank 6+ to access. A dose restores 1d6 Humanity, but not above the maximum therapy allows. It lasts two weeks, or less if the GM rules that stress or trauma wears it off; one dose per two weeks. It doesn't combine with Immunoblockers (Edgerunners Mission Kit) in either order. A Medtech giving therapy to a dosed patient gets +2 to the Medical Tech check; if that check fails, the bonus is used up until the next dose. Priced at its material cost.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Pharmaceuticals).
